claim_limits: The dispatch records interfaces and evidence boundaries; it does not claim that all twelve packages are complete.
Unknown, blocked, failed and budget-truncated states retain their denominators and cannot be promoted to pass.
Synthetic smoke and software tests do not establish chemical validity or confirmatory generalization.
Remote PR states are dated snapshots; offline validation cannot establish their current state or mergeability.

handoff_template.owner_agent: record the real agent/session; never invent an account
handoff_template.unknown_policy: missing evidence is recorded as unknown or blocked and remains outside scientific claims
